question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Precise
solution:
The correct answer is: **Accurate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Precise"** means being exact, clear, and accurate in every detail. (सटीक)

 
 
• **Example: **She gave a precise description of the suspect to the police.
 
 
 
• **"Accurate"** refers to being correct and free from errors, closely resembling the truth. (सही, शुद्ध)
 
 
• **Example: **The data provided in the report is accurate and reliable.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Precise'** is **'Accurate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Accurate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vague** (अस्पष्ट): Something that is unclear or lacks definite shape or meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** His explanation was so vague that I couldn't understand anything.
 
 
 
• **Ambiguous** (अस्पष्ट, दो-अर्थी): Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were ambiguous and led to confusion.
 
 
 
• **Approximate** (लगभग, अनुमानित): Close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.
 
 
• **Example:** The approximate cost of the project is $10,000.
